hero.lede: Penny's Pup Truck rolls up with whipped-cream pup cups, fresh-baked bites, and cute little things for the good dog in your life.

menu.name: The Classic Pup Cup
menu.description: House whipped cream in a mini cup, dusted with a peanut butter drizzle.

menu.name: Frozen Bark-y Pops
menu.description: Pupsicles in pumpkin, blueberry, or banana — served straight from the freezer window.

menu.name: Bakery Bites Box
menu.description: A little box of soft-baked treats — carrot ginger, pumpkin oat, and Peanut butter.

menu.name: Birthday Pup Box
menu.description: A cup, a bandana, and a candle biscuit for the dog turning any age at all.

menu.name: The Bark Bar
menu.description: Bandanas, bow ties, and matching leash charms — pick your pup's look.

menu.name: Pack Punch Card
menu.description: Buy 9 pup cups, the 10th's on the house. Stamped truck-side, every visit.

about.paragraph1: Penny's Pup Truck started as one very good dog's excuse for her owner to bake too many treats. Now she rides shotgun on every route, quality-checking each batch of pup cups before they go out the window.
about.paragraph2: Every recipe is dog-safe first: no xylitol, no chocolate, no added sugar — just things a vet would nod along to.

footerTagline: Serving pup cups & cute dog things around town.
